text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган and I have been
invited to a
special event.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The sun is so bright and twinkly today!
It's the
perfect weather for a
wedding-themed event. ☆
The photos
are gonna turn out great!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That's because I never would've thought
I'd be a
model! I'll have to change super
quickly, and
everyone will be looking at
me...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Wait a second. Who's that looking
around so
restlessly?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Rice! Heyyy! Did you come to
watch the
event?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Eep! A-actually, yes... Weddings are
very happy
events, so I've been looking
forward to it...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: I finished training early so—
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Aaah! W-was that roar just now... from
the rain?!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
The sky suddenly opens up, and down
pours
torrential rain. I'm sure it'll just
pass by, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Darn it. Looks like it's not clearing up.
We could
keep going, but with so few
guests... Should we
cancel?
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
S-sorry... I'm so sorry! This is definitely
my fault.
Please forgive me.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: If I hadn't shown up, then—
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Anyway, we're not gonna cancel
the
shoot. A little bit of rain won't wash
away my
shine!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You see, it'll only make me twinkle
brighter! You
two should just enjoy the
show! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong! ♪ Thanks for waiting,
everyone! ☆
Let's get this party
started—with a parade!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You're so cute, Maya! Ugh... I wish the
weather
were nicer!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
This rain is just one of my accessories! ♪
Here,
take a look! See how it
twinkles? ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
She's right! The rain is catching the light
of the
camera like sequins!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text:
Right?! ♪ But we're just getting started!
Three...
two... one...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Sunshiiine! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Woooow!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Mayano! Everyone
was
smiling... It's like you cast a magic
spell!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks! ☆ My dad actually
taught me how
to read the clouds and
tell when they'll clear.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
He's a pilot who soars through the skies,
after all!
Ehehe!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list:
So you can make the rain a part of your
performance too, huh?

text_block_list.text:
That's right! But what's important isn't
the
weather. Or even the event itself!
What's
important is...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I am everyone's sun!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
When I wore these clothes for the first
time, I
swore that I'd twinkle so that
everyone around me
could twinkle too.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It's what I've always dreamed of! It's
what
grown-up women do!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: U-um... You're all shining so brightly...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
I guess that means I should do my best
too.
There's a twinkle in my heart now...
thanks to you!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
That event was so much fun! But my
absolute
favorite thing is coming up
later—the fireworks
show!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I really wanted to watch
them with
you in my most twinkly outfit,
but it got all wet...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So I'll just have to knock you out with
my outfit
next time, Trainer. ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list:
You shine brighter than anyone else, no matter
what you wear.

Let's work hard so you get invited next time
too.

text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm in a tailspin! Did you just
propose?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Aw, don't be embarrassed! You want us
to run
into the future together, right?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So that means I'll be your sun forever
and ever! ☆
I won't lose a race ever
again!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll get invited next time and the
time after
that. I'll become someone that
these clothes suit
even more, and then—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Th-then... that m-means... th-that...
you'll...
always stay with... me...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hyah! Wh-whoa! The fireworks! Look,
Trainer,
look!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Um... W-well! We've seen the fireworks,
so let's
go home! I'm hungry, and... and...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Listen, um... What I was saying earlier...
I'll
definitely finish telling you someday
when I'm a
bit braver.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: So just wait until then!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган says this with a huge
smile on
her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
